# IconPart

One rounded rectangle of an [Icon](Icon.md), in units of the icon's side.

## Parameters

- `rect`: An array of 4 floats. `[x, y, width, height]` from the icon's top-left corner, each from 0 to 1. Defaults to `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]`.
- `round`: A float. Corner rounding as a share of the part's shorter side, up to 0.5 for a pill or a circle. Defaults to `0.0`.
- `ring`: A float. Outline width as a share of the icon's side; 0 fills the part. Defaults to `0.0`.
